editorial:
Imagine walking into your favorite local breakfast spot only to find out it has turned into a war zone. That is exactly what happens here. You get a wild mix of characters, starting with a fast-talking con man who thinks he can charm his way out of any jam. Then you have rogue federal agents who are not playing by the rules, and a waitress who seems quiet but is actually the most dangerous person in the room. The whole movie feels like a pressure cooker, with all these different personalities clashing in one small space while the stakes get higher every minute.

What really works is how the movie keeps you guessing with its twists. The acting is top-notch, and the action scenes feel real and gritty without being too over the top. While the middle part drags just a little bit, the ending makes up for it with a huge payoff. If you love thrillers that keep you on the edge of your seat, you need to see this. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, you should definitely grab the 4K Blu-ray for your shelf.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the waitress was actually an undercover agent tracking the rogue feds the whole time. In the final shootout, she uses the con man as a distraction to take down the lead agent. After the smoke clears, she lets the con man walk away as a reward for helping her. The movie ends with her cleaning up the diner, showing that she is back to her normal life while the bad guys are gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tight thrillers and unexpected plot twists.
